name: 水肥一体化滴灌配比（EC/pH）调节

map.根据目标 EC 值、水源 EC 与肥料原液 EC，计算滴灌系统的稀释比例与注肥泵: From target EC, source EC, and stock EC, compute the drip system dilution ratio and injector ratio
map.肥料 EC 贡献 = 目标EC − 水源EC；稀释比例 = 肥料EC贡献 ÷ 肥: Fertilizer EC contribution = target EC - source EC; dilution ratio = fertilizer EC contribution / stock EC; injector ratio = dilution ratio x 100%; dilution multiple = 1 / dilution ratio
map.由 EC 差值反推注肥比例：目标 EC 减水源 EC 得需肥料贡献的 EC，除肥: Back-calculate injector ratio from the EC difference: target EC minus source EC gives the needed fertilizer EC, divided by stock EC for dilution ratio; the injector draws stock at this ratio (e.g., 2.5% means stock is 2.5% of irrigation water), and the dilution multiple is its reciprocal. When fertilizer EC contribution <=0 it means source EC already meets the target and no injection is needed. Target pH is reference only, with a 5.5~6.5 suitable-range hint.
map.💡 公式：肥料EC贡献 = 目标EC − 水源EC；稀释比例 = 肥料EC贡献: 💡 Formula: fertilizer EC contribution = target EC - source EC; dilution ratio = fertilizer EC contribution / stock EC; injector ratio (%) = dilution ratio x 100
map.稀释比例指肥料原液占灌溉总体积的比例，对应注肥泵的注肥速率设定: Dilution ratio is the stock share of total irrigation volume, mapping to the injector flow setting
map.多数作物适宜 EC 范围 1.0–2.5 dS/m，pH 5.5–6.5，需根据: Most crops suit EC 1.0-2.5 dS/m and pH 5.5-6.5, adjusted by crop and stage
map.水源 EC 过高时应先处理水源，避免盐分叠加超出目标值: When source EC is too high, treat the water first to avoid salt stacking above target
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据不上传，结果仅供配比参考，需实测校准: Pure front-end, no upload; for ratio reference only, needs measured calibration
map.稀释倍数 = 母液 EC / 目标 EC。: Dilution multiple = stock EC / target EC.
map.先校 pH 至 5.5~6.5 再调 EC。: Calibrate pH to 5.5-6.5 before adjusting EC.
map.用于设施蔬菜不同阶段的营养液管理。: Used for nutrient solution management of facility vegetables by stage.
map.目标 EC 1.5、pH 6.0，母液 EC 20，则稀释 20/1.5 ≈ 1: Target EC 1.5, pH 6.0, stock EC 20, dilution 20/1.5 = 13.3x. First acidify source pH from 7.8 to 6.0, then inject stock to EC 1.5; low concentration in seedling stage prevents salt damage.
map.为什么苗期要低 EC？: Why low EC in seedling stage?
map.幼苗根系嫩、耐盐弱，高 EC 易烧根。随生育推进逐步升 EC 满足需肥，是『少量: Seedling roots are tender and salt-sensitive; high EC burns them. Raise EC gradually with growth to meet demand, following "little and often, low to high".
map.用磷酸或硝酸等酸性物质下调（同时补营养），避免用强碱强酸。每次微调后复测，pH: Use phosphoric or nitric acid (also adds nutrients) to lower; avoid strong alkali/acid. Re-measure after each small adjustment; pH 5.5-6.5 gives best nutrient availability.
map.水肥一体化滴灌配比调节工具，根据目标 EC 值、水源 EC 与肥料原液 EC，计: This tool uses target EC, source EC, and stock EC to compute the fertilizer dilution ratio and injector ratio for drip systems, with target-pH advice for precise fertigation management.
map.自动计算肥料 EC 贡献、稀释比例与稀释倍数: Auto-computes fertilizer EC contribution, dilution ratio, and multiple
map.直接输出注肥泵比例百分比，便于设备设定: Outputs injector ratio percentage directly for device setup
map.水源 EC 超标时智能提示，避免盐分叠加: Smart prompt when source EC exceeds, avoiding salt stacking
